definitions.activity: Observed accepted Yellow Taxi source records; not total transport demand.
definitions.charge: Signed recorded passenger charge USD; not profit; cash tips incomplete.
definitions.coverage: An observed date is not proof of complete service or provider reporting.
definitions.duration: Sum of naive New York wall-clock seconds / accepted count / 60.
definitions.mom: Only adjacent source months compare; missing/zero prior denominator gives null.
definitions.monthly_totals: Source-file month; all accepted pickups, including out-of-partition.
definitions.peak: Largest zone/hour count across scope; earliest hour wins ties.
definitions.quarantine_rate: Distinct quarantined records / source records x 100.
definitions.scope: All active artifacts in one isolated database; fixture/sample/real never mix.
definitions.trips_per_calendar_day: In-partition accepted pickups / days in source-file month.
definitions.trips_per_observed_day: In-partition accepted pickups / distinct observed pickup dates.
definitions.warning_codes: Distinct records per code; counts overlap across different codes.
definitions.warning_rate: Distinct accepted records with >=1 warning / accepted records x 100.
definitions.zone_flags: Rate exceeds source-month rate, with >=10,000 in its own denominator.
definitions.zone_members: Unresolved key 0 and official Unknown keys remain separate members.
